use-case.description: Add a new use case to an existing domain package and wire it into the service module + application service.

service.description: Scaffold a new NestJS HTTP API microservice (apps/{domain}/{domain}-api-service) wired into Nx, the service registry, and local dev tasks.

domain.description: Scaffold a complete new domain: domain package, contracts package, API service, and standard CRUD use cases.

event-handler.description: Scaffold an SQS-consumer event-handler microservice (apps/{domain}/{domain}-event-handler-service). No HTTP layer — produces dispatcher, per-event handler stubs, local poller, and workspace wiring.

ui-primitive.description: Scaffold a new @old-st/ui primitive: component.tsx + index.ts + component.stories.tsx + component.spec.tsx, and add the export to packages/ui/src/index.ts.
